purpose: Account-linking implementation requirements; not an active auth service

openai.availability: Website Sign in with ChatGPT is documented as a limited trial for selected partners; eligibility must be confirmed
openai.flow: Authorization Code with PKCE and OpenID Connect
openai.plan_usage: Separate registration and authorization; identity sign-in does not establish inference usage

requirements: Short-lived one-time sign-in transactions with state and PKCE/nonce where applicable
Server-side code exchange and verified identity
Secrets kept out of HTML, repo files, logs, profiles, and browser storage
Explicit confirmation before linking two provider identities; never assume shared email proves identity
Separate identity, repository permissions, inference grants, and per-action authorization
